title: BuildloopSandboxConfig
description: Configuration for the Buildloop Docker sandbox runner.

command.description: Command and arguments to execute inside the sandbox. Array form prevents shell interpolation.

cwd.description: Working directory. Resolved relative to project root. Must not escape project directory.

image.description: Docker image for the sandbox container.

network_mode.description: Network isolation: offline (default, no network), allowlist (DNS allowlist), full (requires approval).

network_allowlist.description: DNS names allowed when network_mode is allowlist. Required for allowlist mode.

full_network_approved.description: Explicit approval flag required when network_mode is full.

mounts.description: Additional bind mounts. Subject to security validation - secret paths always blocked.

cache_mounts.description: Named Docker volumes for dependency caches.

env.description: Environment variables for the container. Must not include secrets.
